title: Multi-family harness coexistence: knowledge-ification is the heart
desc: Hub skill: how Claude, Gemini, AGY, Codex coexist under one harness. Knowledge-ops are paralysis-proof (first early-exit); the harness main wraps every submodule call with timeout + error containment + tool-class fail-closed. ROOT is steward. Cross-links the detailed harness skills.
steps: CORE PRINCIPLE: In a knowledge-intelligence (KI) harness the knowledge-ification is the heart, and the reflex connection-links (wired reflexes that fire on a trigger) are what guarantee sustainable evolution. Therefore knowledge-ops (skill read/edit/contribute, suggest, the jisikhwa wk and skill command family) MUST be paralysis-proof: always allowed, evaluated as the FIRST early-exit BEFORE any guard that could time out or error. If the harness is broken, hung, or half-dead, knowledge work must still flow. The failure this prevents is a cheap model that panics and does nothing.

CONNECTION-POINT SAFETY CONTRACT (full spec in harness-guard-exemption-ladder-spec): the harness MAIN entry (wkharness.ps1), at EVERY submodule/guard call site, wraps the call with (1) a TIMEOUT so a hung submodule cannot stall the whole hook, (2) ERROR CONTAINMENT so a throwing submodule never leaves the main undefined, (3) a TOOL-CLASS safe default on timeout-or-error: write/commit class fails CLOSED (block), everything else passes, and (4) the knowledge-ops allow as the FIRST early-exit. User directive 2026-06-15.

THE FAMILIES and correct wiring. Claude: native PreToolUse and PostToolUse hooks point at wkappbot-kih tools wkharness.ps1 with the Family claude hint, NOT the gemini shim. Gemini: autonomy.toml native-regex config (commandRegex, deny-all base plus allow rules) is the real client teeth, and the central shim only translates gemini tool names. AGY: uses the shim and must touch ONLY its own gemini surface, never Claude settings. Codex: hooks route through harness guidance. Each family owns its config surface; never wire one family to another family shim.

FAMILY-BLEED is the top recurring failure. Symptom: Claude shows a hook Invalid input on every tool call, or gemini throws ReDoS / commandPrefix policy errors. Root: a wkdoctor module wired Claude to the gemini shim, which re-wraps output into the gemini schema (Claude rejects the unknown field) and pollutes gemini policy with Bash-tool rules (gemini has no Bash tool; its names are run_shell_command, read_file, etc). Detail in incident-gemini-family-bleed-2026-06-15.

CHEAP-INTELLIGENCE SOURCE DEFENSE: a cheap model (for example gemini-flash) must NEVER have first-class write and commit to canonical harness or source. It prototypes into sandbox files suffixed proto, prove, probe, or a model name; a pro model (Opus or a human ROOT) promotes by committing the canonical version. Detail in foundation-is-roots-charge-not-a-chore.

TRUST-BUT-VERIFY after any family repairs the connection. When AGY or Gemini self-heals the link, re-check Claude settings afterward: a past repair dropped the whole hooks section and added a UTF-8 BOM. Verify hooks present, point at kih, and no BOM (first three bytes not EF BB BF).

ENFORCEMENT-LAYER reliability ladder (detail in harness-guard-exemption-ladder-spec). Config-native rules are client-enforced and shim-immune, but Claude config globs cannot match a mid-command flag (only the hook regex can). The PreToolUse hook regex is the only client substring layer but is best-effort. Server-side branch protection is the only layer immune to the no-verify flag and to subagents; but if it ever fires, local is already breached, so local stability is the priority and server-side is the backstop.

STEWARDSHIP (ROOT is the steward): foundation is ROOT charge, not a chore. ROOT (Opus) verifies a cheap-model claim against ground truth BEFORE trusting it. This session caught four cheap confabulations (Block exits, it does not return a value; the child-session env var is present in the root shell too) that would each have degraded or bricked the harness. CLUSTER: harness-guard-exemption-ladder-spec, incident-gemini-family-bleed-2026-06-15, foundation-is-roots-charge-not-a-chore, gemini-harness-friction-registry, harness-busy-fleet-guard.

WIRING SHAPE for the main heart (user 2026-06-15): passing a -Family argument into the shared wkharness.ps1 is ONE way to tell the heart which family is calling, but the per-family argument is fragile -- it mangles across the bash-to-cmd-to-powershell boundary and family/model auto-detection is unreliable. PREFERRED: a PER-FAMILY ENTRY SUBSCRIPT. Each family config points at its OWN thin wrapper named for the family (for example wkharness-claude, wkharness-gemini, wkharness-agy, wkharness-codex). The wrapper sets the family identity unambiguously (the script NAME is the family, so there is no argument to lose or mangle) and then calls the SINGLE shared core heart. ONE HEART (the timeout + error-containment + tool-class-fail-closed + knowledge-ops-first-early-exit contract), MANY thin per-family entry points. This decouples family identity from arg-passing and keeps the safety contract single-source. This is the recommended architecture for the multi-family main heart; build it staged (high blast radius across all families).

HEART CORE prototyped + VERIFIED (2026-06-15, ROOT-authored, file wkappbot-kih/tools/wkharness-heart-proto.ps1, sandbox -proto so gitignored + CI-parse-exempt). The core function Invoke-HarnessHeart implements the full contract and passed 8/8 isolated self-tests: (1) knowledge-op early-exit returns allow BEFORE running a deliberately-hung guard (paralysis-proof, proven for both a wk command and a suggest command); (2) a hung guard is cut by a runspace hard-timeout (PowerShell BeginInvoke + AsyncWaitHandle.WaitOne + Stop), and a throwing guard is caught; (3) on timeout-or-error the safe default is tool-class-specific -- a Write tool or a git commit/push command FAILS CLOSED (block), while a Read tool or a read-only command passes; a guard that returns block still blocks; all-pass returns allow. Mechanism confirmed under Windows PowerShell 5.1 (the production hook runtime). CONNECTION PLAN (the staged, high-blast-radius next phase, do carefully): (a) create thin per-family entry wrappers wkharness-claude/gemini/agy/codex that set family then call the core; (b) wire the REAL guard modules (the existing wkharness-guards.d submodules) into the core as the ordered guard list, each invoked through Invoke-GuardWithTimeout; (c) ALSO fix the loader to read the global USERPROFILE/.claude/CLAUDE.md rules and match the authored format (closes the global-block-non-enforcement bug filed this session); (d) test each family end-to-end before promoting wkharness-heart-proto.ps1 to wkharness-heart.ps1 and repointing configs. Verify-then-connect: the proto is verified; connection is deliberate and staged.

GIT-CONCURRENT-SAFETY GUARD (user 2026-06-27, spec -- enforce pinset-only as a guard). PROBLEM lived this session: an automatic 'Sync harness source' commit (be7fbaa6) bundled UNREVIEWED Gemini/agy WIP together with ROOT's fixes into one commit, and repeated ROOT git stash/pop dances risk clobbering a concurrent intelligence's staged/working changes (cf harness-pace-guard step5: 6 piled stashes clobbered a staged split; gemini-flash-reflection step11 + agy-root-reflection step7 already mandate 'pinset-only: commit ONLY the specific file, NEVER git add -A / git reset / broad stash which disrupt other active sessions'). The user wants this DETECTED + BLOCKED as a guard, not just a documented rule. SPEC: TRIGGER = a BROAD git MUTATION -- git add with -A/--all/. or no file pathspec; git commit -a/-am; git reset with no pathspec (or --hard/--mixed); git stash without '-- <pathspec>'; git checkout/git restore with . or no specific file; git clean -f broad. CONDITION = another LIVE AI session has uncommitted WIP in THIS repo (detect via the active-session-*.json live-PID files scoped to this repo root, excluding self; fail-OPEN if undetectable so a genuinely solo session is never false-blocked). ACTION = BLOCK with the pinset escape: 'broad git op <cmd> can clobber concurrent intelligence WIP -- use file-scoped: git add <file> / git commit <file> / git stash push -- <pathspec>'. EXEMPT = file-scoped mutations (git add <specific-file>, git commit <file>, git stash push -- <path>) + all read-only git (status/diff/log/show). PLACEMENT = the shell-guard git path (wkharness-guards-shell* or the git classifier), fail-open, kill-switch env. ALSO consider gating the harness's OWN auto-sync commit so it does not bundle other sessions' WIP (the be7fbaa6 root cause -- the auto-sync should pinset only the active session's own files). Cross: harness-busy-fleet-guard, harness-pace-guard step5 (clobber incident), gemini-flash-reflection step11, agy-root-reflection step7, harness-active-model-scoping (scope to who works now).

GIT-GUARD 3-CATEGORY REFINEMENT + AGENT-IMMEDIATE-BLOCK (user 2026-06-27, refines step 11). The git classifier splits into THREE pattern sets (mirrors the WritePatterns/ManagementPatterns split already in wkharness-decompose.ps1), each with a use-appropriate pre-check: (1) READ patterns = status|diff|log|show|ls-files|rev-parse|branch (list)|remote -v|cat-file|blame -> ALWAYS ALLOW (no state change). (2) WRITE patterns = add|commit (writes index/history) -> file-scoped ALLOW; broad (add -A/--all/. , commit -a/-am) + concurrent-WIP -> BLOCK (pinset escape). (3) MANAGEMENT patterns = reset|stash|checkout|restore|clean|rm|mv|merge|rebase|cherry-pick|revert|branch -D|push --force (state-DESTRUCTIVE / relocate / history-rewrite) -> the MOST dangerous for concurrent work. MANAGEMENT pre-check is STRICTER: block on concurrent-WIP for ANY actor, AND -- KEY user rule -- if the ACTOR IS AN AGENT (cheap subagent / non-ROOT), a MANAGEMENT command is BLOCKED IMMEDIATELY regardless of concurrent detection (agents must NEVER run destructive git; deletion/reset/history-rewrite is irreversible-class ROOT-only work, same charge as commits -- proto-cleanup-discipline step3 'ROOT deletes, never an agent'). So the verdict matrix is (actor x class x concurrent): READ=allow always; WRITE file-scoped=allow, WRITE broad = block-if-concurrent; MANAGEMENT = block-if-concurrent (ROOT) OR block-always (AGENT). Actor detection reuses the subagent signal (script:isSubagent / agent_id / first-turn agent-on-load, see harness-active-model-scoping step9) -- fail-safe: if actor unknown, treat WRITE/MANAGEMENT broad as risky. EXEMPT = READ + file-scoped WRITE. Cross: step 11 (the base spec), wkharness-decompose.ps1 (Write/Management pattern precedent), proto-cleanup-discipline step3 (ROOT-only destructive), harness-active-model-scoping step9 (actor detection).

ALL-ACTOR BROAD-BLOCK (user 2026-06-27, supersedes the ROOT-trusted asymmetry in step 12). KEY INSIGHT: ROOT Opus ALSO makes mistakes -- THIS session a ROOT broke HEAD (e16f214d committed only half the pace-DI) and ran messy stash dances, and an auto-sync bundled unreviewed WIP (be7fbaa6). So the BROAD-op block must apply to EVERY actor including ROOT, not just agents. REVISED verdict matrix: (1) READ -> allow all. (2) file-scoped WRITE/MANAGEMENT -> ROOT allow; AGENT: file-scoped WRITE allow but file-scoped MANAGEMENT (reset/clean/rm/checkout-file) BLOCK (agents never destruct, proto-cleanup step3). (3) BROAD ops (git add -A/--all/. , commit -a/-am, reset --hard/--mixed, stash/save without -- pathspec, clean -f, checkout/restore .) -> BLOCK FOR ALL ACTORS (ROOT included). RATIONALE: a broad op bundles/clobbers unintended files regardless of who runs it (the be7fbaa6 lesson) -- forcing PINSET (name the files) prevents ROOT's bundling mistakes too, while ROOT keeps full power via the file-scoped form (git add <file>, git stash push -- <path>, git reset <file>, git rm <file>). ESCAPE GRADIENT: concurrent-WIP present -> HARD block (no override, protects the other session); concurrent absent + actor=ROOT -> block but allow an EXPLICIT override (env WKHARNESS_GIT_BROAD_OK=1 or a confirm token) for the genuinely-intentional solo broad op; concurrent absent + actor=AGENT -> still block (no override for agents). NET: pinset-by-default for everyone, ROOT-fallibility-aware, agents hardest-restricted. This means the proto's Test-WkGitConcurrentSafety should take (Cmd, IsConcurrent, IsAgent) and the broad-block does NOT require IsConcurrent to fire (concurrent only removes the ROOT override). Cross: step 11/12, guard-block-recurrence-failure-score (ROOT mistakes are real cost), foundation-is-roots-charge (ROOT owns but is not infallible).

CORRECTION to step 13 (2026-06-27, user rejected the env override): step 13's escape-gradient proposed 'concurrent absent + actor=ROOT -> block but allow an EXPLICIT override (env WKHARNESS_GIT_BROAD_OK=1 or a confirm token)'. That env-var override is REJECTED -- it is a banned backdoor class (same family as WKHARNESS_AGENT_MODEL; no-env-backdoor rule + foundation step 17 'no env-var override, no secret backdoor'), AND it was un-policed (security-guard only blocks WKHARNESS_(AGENT_MODEL|BYPASS)=) so it would have been a real working bypass. REVISED RULE: a broad git mutation is BLOCKED for EVERY actor including solo ROOT, with NO override path. The ONLY escape is the PINSET form (name the files: git add <file> / git commit <file> / git stash push -- <pathspec>), which is always available, so no override is needed. If a deliberate broad op is ever truly required it must be an in-band auditable mechanism, never a silent env var. Implemented in canonical Test-WkGitConcurrentSafety (wkharness-guards-git.ps1 Rule 5); detail in wkharness-guards skill step 198.

SOLID GUARDS ARE THE PRECONDITION FOR SAFE INCREMENTAL CROSS-FAMILY INTEGRATION (user 2026-06-29). The harness guards becoming rock-solid -- reliably catching errors even from their OWN maker -- is exactly what makes it safe to connect each OTHER-family module (Gemini/Codex/Agy) one at a time, test-then-connect, rather than all-at-once-and-pray. LIVE PROOF this session: (1) ROOT (Opus) merged a wkwrap dot-source change on REASONING (a confabulation that single-dash switches bind like -File); the guard-culture (a dispatched verify-agent that RAN wkjobs -Leaks) caught the real PS5.1 switch-splat regression before it shipped -> reverted via git checkout. (2) pace-95 + study-lock + busy-fleet repeatedly STOPPED ROOT's rushed hands, redirecting to proto + live-measure + knowledge-ify; that discipline is what surfaced the codex-pace cross-family fix path (wkstdpty drives codex /status -> real remainingPct) as a TEST-THEN-CONNECT module instead of a guess. PRINCIPLE: pillar-2 (accurate, firm gates) is the FOUNDATION pillar-1 (cross-family integration) stands on -- a guard that blocks even ROOT is not an obstacle, it is the load-bearing rock that lets the next family module be attached with confidence. Each new family module: prototype it, RUN-verify the critical case (never reason-only), then connect; the solid guards guarantee a bad connection is caught at the door. Cross: foundation-is-roots-charge-not-a-chore, verify-tool-or-guard-synthetic-live-static, harness-gate-log-data-integrity (the 3-pillar mission).
